content.text: Puckman is a seminal and hugely influential arcade game in which the player guides the legendary Puckman around a single-screen maze eating dots. Puckman is constantly pursued in his task by four coloured ghosts. Each ghost has its own unique personality and behavioural patterns and a single touch from any of the ghosts results in Puckman losing a life. When all of Puckman's lives are lost, the game is over.
Between certain rounds, intermissions are played featuring Puckman and the ghosts. Three intermissions are present:

items: The red ghost chases Puckman across the screen and off the side. He re-appears running in the opposite direction, having turned blue, followed by a giant Puckman. Played after Round 2.
The red ghost again chases Puckman but rips his red sheet on a nail, revealing a pink body underneath. Played after Round 5.
The red ghost chases Puckman once more, this time with his sheet sewn. They exit left; the ghost returns bare, dragging his sheet. Played after Rounds 9, 13, and 17.
